title: Rain
materials: Household rhythm sticks or wooden spoons
quest_mission: Join Vesta & Silas in Terrasol on an acoustic sensory quest to explore Rain.
rhythm_ignition: Teacher models a steady 2-minute rhythmic call-and-response beat to 'Rain', synchronizing clapping and vocal chanting with the children.
tactile_ritual:
The Hands-On Sensory Discovery:
1. Children gather in a circle with tactile items.
2. Follow the musical cues of Rain to touch, sort, and move in rhythmic unison.
3. Pair high-reach movements with deep somatic exhalations.
4. Freeze in quiet stillness at the final chord.

socratic_wonder_circle.rhythm_cue: 70 BPM Raindrop Finger-Patter (Observe -> Infer -> Test to Know!)
socratic_wonder_circle.wait_time_rule: Hold a calm 4-beat pause after every question before inviting responses.
prompts: Examining Assumptions (S-30): When clear water drops appear outside a cold red berry-water cup, why do many assume the cup leaked—and how does the clear color disprove that assumption?
Evaluating Evidence (S-33): Our song chants 'Watching raindrops falling down, cleaning the atmosphere'—what sights, smells, and puddle clues can we observe right after rain falls?
Intellectual Humility (S-5): Why does a real Terrasol scientist love saying 'I don't know yet—let's design a fair test!' instead of rushing to guess?

age_tier_scaffolds.Sprouts (Ages 2–4): Tap soft 2-finger drizzle vs. 8-finger rain and describe what rain feels and smells like.
age_tier_scaffolds.Pathfinders (Ages 4–5): Compare a dry bean jar and a damp-cloth bean jar to test what rain gives living seeds.
age_tier_scaffolds.Wayfarers (Ages 6–7): Use the red-tinted cold cup condensation check to separate hidden assumptions from empirical evidence.

domain_spider.language: Articulate clear auditory phrasing and target vocabulary connected to Rain.
domain_spider.cognitive: Identify rhythmic patterns, tempo shifts, and conceptual categories in Terrasol.
domain_spider.physical: Gross motor whole-body balance, bilateral coordination, and fine motor finger rhythm.
domain_spider.science_sensory: Tactile exploration of real-world materials and acoustic auditory pitch discrimination.
domain_spider.social_emotional: Cooperative participation, shared attentional focus, and calming self-regulation.

teacher_whisper: Auditory rhythmic pacing stimulates brainstem regulation and synchronizes attention across the classroom without visual screen fatigue.

standards.kindergarten_readiness: Actively participates in screen-free multi-sensory rhythm rituals and articulates key conceptual observations.
